questions.question: What is the Development Levy and which taxes does it replace?
questions.ground_truth: The legislation also introduces the Development Levy, set at 4%, which applies to the assessable profits… It replaces several existing taxes, such as the Tertiary Education Tax, Information Technology Levy, National Agency for Science and Engineering Infrastructure (NASENI) Levy, and the Police Trust Fund Levy.

questions.question: What is the minimum effective tax rate for large companies?
questions.ground_truth: Companies with an annual turnover of ₦50 billion or above, or those belonging to a multinational group with global turnover exceeding EUR750million, are now required to pay a minimum effective tax rate (ETR) of 15% on net income

questions.question: How is capital gains tax revised?
